title: Accountant cum CRM
description:
**Job Title: Accountant cum CRM Executive**

**Company:** Shanoor Projects & Realtors Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Ulloor, Thiruvananthapuram

**Job Description:**

We are looking for an Accountant cum CRM Executive to handle day-to-day accounting activities and customer relationship management. The candidate should have good accounting knowledge, communication skills, and the ability to coordinate with customers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handle daily accounting transactions, vouchers, and financial records.
* Manage sales invoices, receipts, payments, and bank reconciliation.
* Assist in GST filing and other accounting-related activities.
* Maintain customer records and update CRM data.
* Handle customer queries, follow-ups, and feedback.
* Coordinate with customers regarding payments, documentation, and project updates.
* Maintain proper documentation and generate periodic reports.
* Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely customer service.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification.
* 2–3 years of relevant experience preferred.
* Knowledge of Tally / accounting software and MS Excel.
* Basic knowledge of GST and accounting procedures.
* Experience in CRM or customer coordination will be an added advantage.
* Good communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.

**Job Type:** Full-time

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
